mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 70 degrees out by Reddan Soccer Park. Under the Third Quarter moon, we have a quick ISS sighting at 5:54 AM. Look toward the northwest near Cross Plains as it rises and heads toward the southeast near Oregon, reaching about halfway up the sky.

The City of Verona has installed a new piece of public art called the Tai Chi Animal Frolics tree in Century School Park. Carved from a fallen ash tree by local artists, the sculpture features animal forms inspired by Tai Chi movements and serves as a welcoming landmark for the community.
There is plenty to do this week. Today you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness or join Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow brings live music to Bailey's Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company.

In a report covering August 24 through August 31, an incident occurred on August 30 where a 21-year-old man intentionally smashed a vehicle window on North Edge Trail and fled the scene; a warrant is currently active for his arrest.
Today's flavor of the day is Snickers Swirl. The store is currently closed for the morning but will open today at 10:00 AM and remain open until 10:00 PM.
